extract_config.text:
AIA Group Limited announces 13 per cent growth in value of new business (VONB) on constant exchange rates (CER) for the first quarter ended 31 March 2026.
Growth rates are shown on a constant exchange rate basis.
VONB up 13 per cent to US$1,757 million.
Annualised new premiums (ANP) increased by 16 per cent to US$3,152 million.
VONB margin continued to be strong at 56.0 per cent.
Lee Yuan Siong, AIA's Group Chief Executive and President, said: Our two largest markets, Mainland China and Hong Kong, achieved excellent growth of more than 20 per cent in the quarter.
